page0.text:
...
I can't just watch and do nothing.
The uneven footing prevents Saber from gaining ground on Rider.
The two clash in the air, rushing up to the rooftop.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page0:1

page1.text:
"Oh, the rooftop...!"
If Rider came flying down from the top of the building, chances are Shinji is there!
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page1:1

page2.text:
We have two possible ways to win our fight against Rider.
Either we defeat her directly, or we defeat her Master...but whichever it is, it has to be before she deploys her Noble Phantasm.
While Saber's fighting Rider, there's only one thing I should be doing!
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page2:1

page3.text:
The two shadows climb upwards.
They continue to distance themselves from the ground, gaining more and more altitude.
Neither needs proper footing. They just kick their way up along the wall.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page3:1

page4.text:
As it happens...
...they clash countless times, all before they ever reach the top.
Were anyone watching from the ground, they'd probably think they were seeing a game of pinball.
Though I doubt they'd be able to follow the two with the naked eye.
It's like a deadly circus act...the collisions are barely discernible, invisible to normal human beings.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page4:1

page5.text:
"..."
Saber had no desire to be a part of this crazy circus act.
She may be a Servant, but she can't fly through the sky.
She might be able to run up along the building's wall, but that's it.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page5:1

page6.text:
This is no better than a free fall for her.
She alternates between kicking off from the building before she loses momentum and slowing to let gravity take hold of her.
It may be no exaggeration to say she's falling into the sky.
Now that she's started, she'll continue all the way up to the rooftop.
And in that entire journey, if her opponent hits her, she'll be hurled to the ground.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page6:1

page7.text:
But...
It seems the laws of gravity do not apply to the enemy, to the opponent Saber has to defeat.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page7:1

page8.text:
The streak of purple shoots across the side of the building in pursuit of Saber while Saber focuses on reaching the roof.
Gravity has no hold on Rider. She leaps around effortlessly, moving in and from all directions...up, down, left, right...to strike at Saber.
Her long hair trails out behind her like a comet tail, and she looks like a snake wrapping itself around a log.
"Guh...!"
Saber's feet touch the wall.
She leans sideways and kicks the wall, aiming for the edge of the building.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page8:1

page9.text:
Saber suddenly shoots out at a right angle to her previous trajectory.
Not one of the attacks finds its mark.
Rider is simply no match for Saber's raw power.
Saber shakes Rider off with a single kick, then kicks upward once again when she reaches the building's side.
She aims herself upward.
If Rider is a like a serpent coiling around the building, Saber is like a bursting spark.
But it looks like Rider might have predicted her moves.
The distance between them remains the same.
Rider continues along the side of the building, not letting Saber open any distance between them. She strikes every time Saber has to take a step!
"Kngh...!"
Saber fends Rider off with her blade and jumps to put some space between them.
Though she's able to fend off Rider's coiling pursuit, there's only so much she can do in the air.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page9:1

page10.text:
Where before there had been no contest in their combat ability, they are now more evenly matched.
Neither has an attack that can bring this to a close.
No. Rider is withholding her own deadliest attack.
Every time Saber leaps at Rider, Rider fends off her attack, but never counterattacks.
Rider is only keeping Saber at bay as she makes her way to the rooftop.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page10:1

page11.text:
"Kn... Do you not intend to fight, Rider!?"
Saber curses at her cowardly enemy.
To a knight like Saber, a fight like this is as good as an insult.
Such a thing should involve both opponents giving their all in their clash.
By that belief, Rider's actions are disrespectful.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page11:1

page12.text:
"Fufu. It appears you do not like heights, Saber."
Rider's voice is cool.
She's right. Saber is clearly not used to fighting in the air.
This is probably a first for her, actually.
Knights are meant to fight on solid ground.
They're not supposed to cling to walls, like her opponent.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page12:1

page13.text:
"Your proud sword won't do you any good here. But do not worry. I will give you your rest soon."
Rider moves upward, her manner inviting.
She's set this whole thing up.
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page13:1

page14.text:
...
Saber understands that though.
At the end of this circus...
Yes...Rider's ideal positioning must be waiting up above.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page14:1

page15.text:
Rider can't use her trump card so readily.
....Which is why she's luring her prey to a place there will be no interruptions, so they can settle this with her ultimate attack.
As soon as she reaches the roof, she'll be in a difficult position.
If Rider's Noble Phantasm is exactly what Saber thinks it is, she won't have any defense against it.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page15:1

page16.text:
But there is no turning back now.
We just can't ignore Rider, or her Master.
This isn't about defeating an enemy in the Holy Grail War.
Saber must defeat Rider here and now to protect her Master.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page16:1

page17.text:
...Because she has no other choice.
This whole situation must be absolutely dumbfounding for her.
She's probably thought more than once about not wanting to push her Master to do anything crazy.
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page17:1

page18.text:
The two continue gaining altitude.
Their rapid clashes ring out across the building as the battle approaches its final destination.
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page18:1

page19.text:
"Damn! Why's it only go up to the fortieth floor!?"
I rush up the stairs while I complain.
I manage to enter the building from the back, but the elevator doesn't go all the way to the roof.
I have to run up the remaining ten flights of stairs.
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page19:1

page20.text:
"Ha...hah...hah...haaah!"
I climb the stairs as fast as I can.
I'm not sure how long it's been since Saber and I split up.
Probably less than ten minutes, but that's too long.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page20:1

page21.text:
You never know how or when a battle will end.
Even Saber's not perfect.
She could make a mistake and get into trouble.
So before that happens...if I can make Shinji use up his Command Spells, Rider might stop fighting.
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page21:1

page22.text:
"Kngh...ha...ha!"
The harder I run, the more my still-healing body aches.
Sprinting around the building, then up the stairs, has left me out of breath.
But I don't slow down. No, I speed up.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page22:1

page23.text:
Something about this has me worried.
I'm not sure why, but my chest hurts.
It's not a physical pain. Something is warning me of danger ahead.
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page23:1

page24.text:
...Saber can't win.
There's something on this rooftop that shouldn't be faced.
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page24:1

page25.text: I try to shake this feeling off and focus on climbing the stairs.
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page25:1

page26.text:
The wind is strong.
The moment I open the door, the city's nightscape fills my field of vision.
Scorch marks pock the concrete.
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page26:1

page27.text:
And at its center...
...at the heart of the burned, scarred rooftop...Saber is on her knees.
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page27:1

page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page28:1

page29.text:
Saber's shoulders heave with her labored breathing.
The moment I rush to her, I notice something strange floating up above me.
Or rather...
...the sheer, overwhelming amount of magical energy forces me to take notice.
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page29:1

page30.text:
"Wha...!?"
I look up towards the sky.
Flapping wings. I hear flapping wings.
Something, a paler and more blinding white than the light of the moon, hovers over me.
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page30:1

page31.text:
It is...
A legendary Mystic I've only heard about in myth.
page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-01:page31:1
